#AcneTreatment can seem overwhelming, but here is a basic primer. Ingredients to look for are salicylic acid, adapalene, and benzoy! peroxide. There's also azelaic acid, sulfur, niacinamide, glycolic acid, succinic acid, and others. But the first three are the main work horse ingredients. If these don't work, then I would see your trusty board-certified derm for other options.

Annndddd here’s the method cus I hate to be annoying: 1. Azelaic acid + a retinoid 2. Barrier serum twice per day 3. Moisturiser AND sunscreen for max hydration 4. Double cleansing with an oil based cleanser that matches my specific criteria (too long to explain here, but there are some specific ingredients I recommend avoiding if you're acne-prone that will help you be much more successful with oil cleansers) 5. LED mask Rinse and repeat for the next five years. My whole method is based around the fundamentals of skin never changing. Skincare companies can release tonnes of new products that are all new and exciting. That doesn't mean our skin actually needs them. In fact, they rarely do. A deep dive into the method is pinned on my profile. I also made a completely free downloadable guide on how to introduce a retinoid, plus I have a 45-minute YouTube video coming out on Sunday on how to use a retinoid azelaic acid for MAX results. 💚 #skincare #skincaretips

I think a lot of people who claim to hate wearing body lotion, butters, and oils don’t *actually* have a problem with moisture- they have a problem with feeling super slick and oily when they put on body care! I like having glowy skin, but that’s a secondary concern- the product has to FEEL good and not overstimulate me instantly lol. Especially during warmer weather! Glowy skin also isn’t the only indication of HEALTHY skin, and you shouldn’t feel bad if your skin looks… like natural skin lol.  Sensory issues are so prevalent, but many people may not understand that the discomfort they’re experiencing is due to sensory issues. Luckily for you, I’m currently working on a body moisturizer roundup for people who struggle with sensory issues and want body care that feels undetectable!
